subject.title: fix(plugins): prevent npm 12 metadata failures from disabling healthy plugins

question: Should maintainers consolidate the complete fix into this PR or into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107063, and should the unique `update-check.ts` npm 12 normalization ship with the plugin-state repair?
rationale: Both branches repair the P0 state-loss path, but only this PR includes the sibling parser fix while the competing PR currently has stronger live behavior proof; automation should not choose which contributor branch becomes canonical.

options.title: Consolidate into competing PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107063 as the canonical state-preservation branch, add the reviewed `update-check.ts` singleton-array fix there, and close this PR after equivalent coverage is present.

options.title: Complete this PR
options.body: Keep this broader branch canonical and require a live exact-head `openclaw update repair` before/after transcript before merge.

options.title: Split the sibling fix
options.body: Land the proven state-preservation PR and submit the independent core update-check normalization as a separate narrow PR with focused coverage.

recommendation.title: Consolidate into competing PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107063 as the canonical state-preservation branch, add the reviewed `update-check.ts` singleton-array fix there, and close this PR after equivalent coverage is present.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant history connects this owner to both the update failure policy and the sibling update-check parser, making them the best available routing candidate for consolidation.
